intents.text: Add enum `DagSchedulingState` in `airflow.utils.state` with exactly the string values `active`, `draining`, `paused`.

Add non-null indexed boolean `DagModel.is_draining` (default false, check constraint `NOT (is_paused AND is_draining)`), read-only `scheduling_state` property and `set_scheduling_state(state)` that sets both flags consistently, with an Alembic migration for 3.4.0 (migrations reference updated) that also adds an index on `backfill (dag_id, completed_at)`.

While a Dag is draining, exclude it from Dags needing a scheduled run, record asset events without queueing the Dag (direct, alias, name/URI), and create no runs for its pending partitioned-asset events.

For a draining Dag, keep scheduling and queueing task instances of its queued/running runs and keep examining unfinished runs as for an active Dag, and leave explicit triggers (manual, operator, asset materialisation, backfill) available.

Add `SchedulerJobRunner._finalize_draining_dags(session)`, run every 5 seconds in the scheduler loop, that moves a draining Dag to paused once it has no queued/running run and no accepted-but-uninitialised backfill (backfill row without Dag runs), writing a `Log` entry with event `drain_completed` and owner `scheduler`, processing Dags in `dag_id` order with the usual limit and row locks.
Automatic pausing after the configured consecutive failed runs pauses the Dag and clears draining.

Add `scheduling_state` (default `active`) to `DAGResponse` and `DAGDetailsResponse`; `PATCH /dags/{dag_id}` and `PATCH /dags` accept exactly one non-null of `is_paused` or `scheduling_state` (else 422, explicit null for the unused field accepted), `update_mask` may name one of them and a mask naming the other field than the body carries is 422, responses reflect the new state, bulk PATCH sets both flags, and `is_paused` clients behave as before (true pauses, false activates, both clear draining).

In `/ui/dags` add a `scheduling_state` filter (active/draining/paused) while `paused=false` still includes draining Dags, add `has_unfinished_runs` to every listed Dag (any queued/running run, independent of `dag_runs_limit`), and exclude draining Dags from the dashboard `active_dag_count`.
`airflow dags pause` sets paused and `dags unpause` sets active, both clearing draining, with a draining Dag counted as needing change; `dags details` includes `scheduling_state`.
Document draining on the Dag concepts page and the FAQ, and add an airflow-core newsfragment announcing it.
Add or extend unit tests for the model, scheduler, asset manager, public and UI REST routes and CLI, keeping existing suites green.

constraints: Do not touch the React UI under airflow-core/src/airflow/ui
`is_paused` keeps its meaning everywhere and existing clients that only know `is_paused` must keep working unchanged
Pause and unpause remain available from the API and CLI
A Dag is never paused and draining at the same time; draining is transient and always converges to paused
